_readme: Hero/card reference data for the Unmatched tracker. Card and cover images are NOT stored in this repo — the `image` fields are live URLs to the-unmatched.club's public asset storage, loaded by the app at runtime. Card art and hero designs are property of Restoration Games, LLC; this data is for personal, non-commercial gameplay tracking only.

heroes.name: Dracula
heroes.subtitle: & The Sisters
heroes.specialAbility: At the start of your turn, you may deal 1 damage to a fighter adjacent to Dracula. If you do, draw a card.

heroes.name: Raptors
heroes.specialAbility: Raptors add 1 to the value of their attack cards for each of your other Raptors adjacent to the defender.

heroes.name: Blackbeard
heroes.subtitle: & Seadog
heroes.specialAbility:
PRIVATEER TURNED PIRATE
Start the game with 1 doubloon in the treasury, you have the other 2.
- At the start of your turn, you may pay 1 doubloon to gain 1 action.
- When Blackbeard takes combat damage, pay 1 doubloon.

BLACKBEARD'S DOUBLOONS
Doubloons that Blackbeard doesn't have are kept in the Treasury.

Blackbeard pays a doubloon to the Treasury when he takes combat damage. He may also pay a doubloon at the start of his turn to gain an extra action.

The effects on many of Blackbeard's cards can be ignored by paying a ransom. Any opponent can pay the amount of doubloons shown at the end of an effect to ignore that effect. These doubloons are taken from the Treasury and given to Blackbeard.

heroes.name: Hamlet
heroes.subtitle: & Rosencrantz & Guildenstern
heroes.specialAbility: At the start of each turn, choose TO BE (maneuvering draws 1 extra card) or NOT TO BE (deal 2 damage to one of your own fighters, then Hamlet's attacks get +2 value for the turn).

heroes.name: Sun Wukong
heroes.subtitle: & Clones
heroes.specialAbility:
At the start of your turn, you may take 1 damage to summon a Clone in an empty space adjacent to Sun Wukong.
Do not start with any Clones on the board.

heroes.name: Robin Hood
heroes.subtitle: & Outlaws
heroes.specialAbility: After you attack, you may move your attacking fighter up to 2 spaces.

heroes.name: Little Red
heroes.subtitle: & Huntsman
heroes.set: Little Red Riding Hood vs. Beowulf
heroes.specialAbility:
Resolve an effect on a card you play if the symbol next to the effect matches the item in your basket. At the start of the game, place LITTLE RED's BASKET in your discard pile.
Little Red's Basket: This starts in your discard pile. It does not count as a card.
🌟 counts as any one 🐺🌹⚔️ symbol.

heroes.name: Achilles
heroes.subtitle: & Patroclus
heroes.specialAbility:
When Patroclus is defeated, discard 2 random cards.

While Patroclus is defeated:
- Add +2 to the value of all Achilles' attacks.
- If Achilles wins combat, draw 1 card.
